args.article: Today's AI agent landscape is shifting from experimentation to production. Open-source frameworks are seeing triple adoption, while model-driven agents are replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups. Tool-calling reliability has become the key benchmark for frontier models, and multi-agent swarms are entering regulated enterprise workflows. New observability standards are also emerging to trace agent decisions end to end.
